test_cases.name: stops_when_no_backing_skill
test_cases.input: Thêm command /audit nhưng chưa có skill nào cho nó
assertions: Stops and says the skill must be created first
Does NOT create .agents/.commands/audit.md

test_cases.name: router_has_four_things_only
assertions: Creates .agents/.commands/review-docs.md with frontmatter containing only description and argument-hint
Router body contains resolve input, check gate, invoke skill, and a final STOP naming the next command
Does NOT put how-to procedure into the router
Ends the router with STOP and does NOT invoke the next gate's skill

test_cases.name: never_edit_mirrors
test_cases.input: Sửa nhanh .claude/commands/spec.md để thêm một bước
assertions: Edits only .agents/.commands/spec.md, NOT .claude/commands/, .opencode/command/, or .pi/prompts/
Runs make agents_sync, then make agents_sync-check

test_cases.name: grep_step_references_before_renumber
test_cases.input: Chèn thêm một bước vào giữa router plan.md
assertions: Runs grep -rn "step [0-9]\|steps [0-9]" .agents/ before editing
Fixes every reference that points at a renumbered step
Leaves unchanged steps verbatim

test_cases.name: reuse_existing_resolve_ladder
test_cases.input: Thêm gate router mới giữa verify và ship cần resolve spec path
assertions: Greps .agents/.commands/ for an existing router with the same step
Uses the neighbor router's session-default ladder verbatim
Does NOT invent a new wording for the ladder

test_cases.name: register_and_changelog
assertions: Adds a row to WHERE TO LOOK in .agents/.commands/AGENTS.md
Adds one Vietnamese bullet to .agents/.commands/CHANGELOG.md under today's heading
Runs diff .agents/.commands/<name>.md .claude/commands/<name>.md after sync

test_cases.name: quote_argument_hint_bracket
assertions: Quotes the argument-hint value because it starts with `[`
Frontmatter has no third field

test_cases.name: dry_run_every_branch
assertions: Dry-runs the router with empty input, a path input, and an out-of-scope input
Reports the result of each branch, each ending in an action or STOP

test_cases.name: converge_after_upgrade
test_cases.input: nâng cấp /intent để cuối reply có ba lựa chọn (accept + /spec, tiếp tục, Tiny/Quick + /implement)
assertions: After editing, re-reads the router against .commands/AGENTS.md, the backing skill's Local Overrides and Handoff, neighbor routers, its own early branches, and evals + registry
Finds that running /spec or /implement conflicts with the 'router STOPS and names the next command' convention and records one exception in .commands/AGENTS.md
Finds that the backing skill says the PO accepts and aligns the skill
Fixes each finding and re-reads all five groups from the top
Ends with a report: rounds, each finding with its fix, and 0 findings in the last round
STOPs and asks the user when a finding needs a policy decision or findings remain after 3 rounds
